stemEn: An 11-year-old girl with a seizure disorder on multiple antiseizure medications and poor clinic follow-up presented with a breakthrough afebrile seizure. The seizure stopped after one dose of lorazepam. What should be done next?
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر هو فحص antiseizure medication levels، خصوصًا لأنها تستخدم عدة أدوية مع poor follow-up واحتمال عدم الالتزام. يذكر شرح المصدر كذلك أهمية bedside glucose وelectrolytes/calcium بحسب السياق، لكنه يوضح أن electrolytes لم تكن ضمن خيارات 2024.
incorrectOptionsAr: Video EEG أو neuroimaging أو LP ليست الخطوة التالية المعتادة إذا عاد الطفل إلى baseline ولا توجد قرائن focal deficit أو CNS infection في النص المسترجع.
clinicalPearl: في breakthrough seizure لدى مريض معروف بالصرع، تحقق من drug level/الالتزام قبل توسيع التصوير إذا لا توجد red flags.

tts.text: An eleven-year-old girl with a seizure disorder on multiple antiseizure medications and poor clinic follow-up presented with a breakthrough afebrile seizure. The seizure stopped after one dose of lorazepam. What should be done next? Option A. Video EEG. Option B. Check antiseizure medication levels. Option C. Brain CT and lumbar puncture. Option D. Brain MRI.

stemEn: A child presented to the ER with an active convulsion and a history of fever. What should be done next?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار lorazepam كخطوة أولى في active convulsion قبل الانتقال إلى second-line antiseizure therapy.
incorrectOptionsAr: Phenytoin ليس first-line قبل benzodiazepine في active convulsive seizure حسب ترتيب العلاج المذكور في المصدر.
clinicalPearl: ابدأ benzodiazepine في active convulsion ثم صعّد العلاج إذا استمرت النوبة.

tts.text: A child presented to the emergency room with an active convulsion and a history of fever. What should be done next? Option A. Give lorazepam. Option B. Give phenytoin.

stemEn: A 10-year-old child presented with an active convulsion. Multiple doses of benzodiazepines were given but he is still convulsing. What should be done next?
explanationAr: بعد فشل benzodiazepines واستمرار convulsion، يختار المصدر phenytoin كـ second-line therapy.
incorrectOptionsAr: لم يعرض المصدر خيارات أخرى لهذا recall، لذلك لا تُضاف مقارنات غير موجودة.
clinicalPearl: Persistent convulsion after benzodiazepine requires second-line antiseizure medication.

tts.text: A ten-year-old child presented with an active convulsion. Multiple doses of benzodiazepines were given but he is still convulsing. What should be done next? Option A. Give phenytoin.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection, 4th Edition, 1 May 2026

stemEn: A child with ongoing convulsions has already received lorazepam, phenytoin and phenobarbital but is still convulsing. What should be done next?
explanationAr: المصدر يصنف الحالة كـ refractory status epilepticus ويختار continuous midazolam infusion بعد فشل الأدوية السابقة.
incorrectOptionsAr: إعادة الجرعات السابقة ليست الخيار الذي اعتمده المصدر بعد فشل benzodiazepine + phenytoin + phenobarbital.
clinicalPearl: بعد فشل عدة خطوط من العلاج، ينتقل management إلى continuous anesthetic infusion في PICU.

tts.text: A child with ongoing convulsions has already received lorazepam, phenytoin and phenobarbital but is still convulsing. What should be done next? Option A. Repeat phenobarbital. Option B. Repeat phenytoin. Option C. Start midazolam infusion.

subtopic: Seizure with possible trauma and airway priority
stemEn: A child was found unresponsive on the road and arrived with a cervical collar. He has mouth-angle and eye jerking. What should be done next?

options.text: Put him on a non-rebreather face mask

explanationAr: المصدر يختار oxygenation أولًا عبر non-rebreather mask، بما يعكس ABC priority قبل imaging أو إزالة cervical protection.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا تُزال cervical collar في trauma غير المستبعد. CT يأتي بعد stabilization. Lorazepam قد يلزم للنوبة لكن مفتاح المصدر قدّم oxygenation أولًا.
clinicalPearl: Stabilize airway/breathing first in an unresponsive possibly injured child.

tts.text: A child was found unresponsive on the road and arrived with a cervical collar. He has mouth-angle and eye jerking. What should be done next? Option A. Put him on a non-rebreather face mask. Option B. Remove the cervical collar. Option C. Give lorazepam. Option D. Head CT.

stemEn: A 1-year-old boy with a complex febrile seizure developed severe respiratory depression after two doses of lorazepam. His respiratory rate is 7 per minute. What is the next step?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار intubation لأن RR 7 يمثل inadequate ventilation بعد sedative exposure؛ priority هي airway and ventilation rather than antidote-first approach.
incorrectOptionsAr: Phenytoin لا يعالج respiratory failure. Naloxone مخصص للـopioids. Flumazenil ليس الخيار المختار في هذا السيناريو ذي seizure history/benzodiazepine exposure.
clinicalPearl: Inadequate ventilation is an airway emergency: secure the airway and ventilate.

tts.text: A one-year-old boy with a complex febrile seizure developed severe respiratory depression after two doses of lorazepam. His respiratory rate is seven per minute. What is the next step? Option A. Intubation. Option B. Administer phenytoin. Option C. Administer flumazenil. Option D. Administer naloxone.

stemEn: A child developed bradycardia and severe respiratory depression after two doses of lorazepam for abscess drainage. Bag-mask ventilation was started but oxygen saturation remains 89%. What is the next step?
explanationAr: استمرار desaturation مع bradycardia رغم bag-mask ventilation يجعل definitive airway هو مفتاح المصدر: intubation.
incorrectOptionsAr: Flumazenil أو naloxone لا يتقدمان على securing the airway عند فشل التهوية والأكسجة.
clinicalPearl: Persistent hypoxemia despite BVM requires escalation to a definitive airway.

tts.text: A child developed bradycardia and severe respiratory depression after two doses of lorazepam for abscess drainage. Bag-mask ventilation was started but oxygen saturation remains eighty-nine percent. What is the next step? Option A. Intubation. Option B. Administer flumazenil. Option C. Administer naloxone.

stemEn: A child with febrile seizure developed severe respiratory depression after two doses of lorazepam and requires intubation. Which medication should be used for induction?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار midazolam لأن لديه antiepileptic properties ويمكن استخدامه كـ induction agent في RSI ضمن status epilepticus.
incorrectOptionsAr: Topiramate وphenytoin وphenobarbital ليست induction agents المعتادة للـRSI في هذا السياق حسب شرح المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Choose an induction agent that also supports seizure control when intubating a patient with ongoing/recent status epilepticus.
